interface.signature: def canMeasureWater(x: int, y: int, z: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: The capacity of the first jug must be non-negative.
The capacity of the second jug must be non-negative.
The target amount of water must be non-negative.
The target amount of water must not exceed the combined capacity of both jugs.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (z == 0 or (z % gcd(x, y) == 0 and z <= x + y))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if z is measurable, which occurs if z is zero or if z is a multiple of the greatest common divisor of x and y and does not exceed the total capacity.
